description: This file defines a NotificationService class responsible for creating notification channels and displaying notifications related to leaves in an Android application.

classes.name: NotificationService
classes.description: Handles creation of notification channels and displaying leave reminder notifications.

methods.name: createNotificationChannel
methods.description: Creates a notification channel for calendar events if the Android version supports it.

methods.name: showLeaveReminder
methods.description: Displays a notification reminding the user about an upcoming leave.
